# Vendored am-fs-squashfs 0.1.3

This is the unchanged library source from the previously locked crates.io release.
Fresh CI stopped resolving `am-fs-squashfs` after its index/API became unavailable
(404); the static archive endpoint also returned 403. Avoid an unrelated filesystem
implementation upgrade while validating startup changes.

- Upstream: https://github.com/antimatter-studios/rust-fs-squashfs
- Published source commit: `f88738951f576e4882c514991b27fef8cc543494`
- Original archive: `am-fs-squashfs-0.1.3.crate`
- Archive SHA-256: `21c43fbe11c700efcd4ce9cba92f66886addc0b660e3e032cac3e4bcecf116ab`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE`.

Recovered from a cached archive whose SHA-256 matches the existing committed
Cargo.lock checksum. The normalized published Cargo.toml is used, preserving
registry dependencies rather than the upstream development-only sibling path.
Library/CLI source, tests, fixture, header and release metadata are preserved.
Upstream Git hooks, CI automation and toolchain overrides are not installed.
No library source edits were made as part of vendoring.
